# Claude classifier fixture provenance

These fixtures are sanitized response examples for the D10b classifier. They contain no credentials or request IDs.

| Fixture | Provenance |
| --- | --- |
| `shared_five_hour_rejection.json` | Composed from the observed `five_hour` representative-claim spelling and reset format in [anthropics/claude-code#12829](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/12829), the explicit five-hour rejection category in [CLIProxyAPI's pinned classifier test](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/acdace936fa7df2905500c7f5e0a97d683138dea/internal/runtime/executor/claude_executor_fable_ratelimit_test.go), and the D10b-required unified `rejected` status. The issue capture itself had unified status `allowed`; this fixture combines the observed header spelling/reset with the tested 429 rejected-window shape and is not presented as one captured response. |
| `shared_weekly_rejection.json` | Composed from the `seven_day` weekly name shown in [anthropics/claude-code#29300](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/29300), the explicit shared 7-day rejection category in the pinned [CLIProxyAPI classifier test](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/acdace936fa7df2905500c7f5e0a97d683138dea/internal/runtime/executor/claude_executor_fable_ratelimit_test.go), and the D10b-required unified `rejected` status. It documents the intended classifier input shape; it is not a single captured response. |
| `oauth_credential_rejection.json` | Sanitized body from the reported 401 response in [anthropics/claude-code#18225](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/18225). The request ID is omitted. |
| `capability_authentication_401.json` | Sanitized body from the unsupported-OAuth 401 reported in [anthropics/claude-code#9887](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/9887). It has `authentication_error` but does not identify an invalid or expired token, so D10b passes it through. The issue does not include response headers; `content-type` is supplied as fixture framing. |
| `overage_only_rejection.json` | Sanitized header/body shape from the `Issue5915` and `Issue5920` overage-only test cases at the pinned [CLIProxyAPI classifier test](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/acdace936fa7df2905500c7f5e0a97d683138dea/internal/runtime/executor/claude_executor_fable_ratelimit_test.go). Account identifiers and unrelated transport fields are omitted. |
| `model_only_rejection.json` | Sanitized Fable-only response shape from the pinned [CLIProxyAPI `FableOnlyRejectionIsModelScoped` test](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/acdace936fa7df2905500c7f5e0a97d683138dea/internal/runtime/executor/claude_executor_fable_ratelimit_test.go). The `7d_oi` window is model-scoped; account-wide 5h and 7d statuses are allowed. |
| `bare_429.json` | Minimal generic 429 fixture. The error type `rate_limit_error` and 429 meaning follow Anthropic's [API error documentation](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/errors); message text is minimized, and there are no quota headers or representative claim. |

The subscription unified-window headers are observed but are not a documented public Messages API contract. The tests therefore require only the D10b evidence boundary: unified status `rejected` plus an exact shared representative claim (`five_hour` or `seven_day`). They do not treat HTTP 429, an `authentication_error`, a model window, or overage signals alone as account-wide evidence.
